From: privacy@clientco.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Data erasure request — prompts/outputs/logs (acct 0987)

Hi Lauren,

Per ClientCo internal privacy process (GDPR Article 17), we are submitting a formal request to delete all prompt/input text, model outputs, and associated request/response logs for our account (ClientCo acct 0987). Please include deletion of:
- prompt payloads and generated outputs stored in prompt-output logs
- inference request/response traces and diagnostics (per-request logs)
- any cached KV entries or prefix caches used by Redwood that could contain ClientCo session state
- S3-backed archived logs retained for >30 days

We need a confirmation of the planned workflow, expected timeline, and a downloadable evidence package (deletion audit) once completed. Also confirm whether any cross-region replicas (eu-west-1 / eu-central-1) will be affected and how long invalidation will take.

Please treat this as time-sensitive; legal has requested closure within 7 business days.

Thanks,
Jacob Simmons
Data Privacy, ClientCo
privacy@clientco.com

(attachments: clientco-erasure-form.pdf)

Subject: Re: Data erasure request — prompts/outputs/logs (acct 0987)

Hi Jacob — thanks for the clear request and the form. We're able to process this via our self-serve erasure workflow to provide faster evidence and an auditable trail. Quick summary of next steps: 

1) Confirm the account ID (I have acct 0987) and the scope (prompts, outputs, logs, kv cache, archived S3 objects).
2) If you initiate the request from the ClientCo portal (link below) it triggers an automated job and notifies our ops team for any manual steps. Otherwise we can kick it off on your behalf.
3) Expected timeline: automated purge + cache invalidation typically completes within 24–48 hours for EU-only data; full cross-region invalidation may take up to 72 hours depending on replica propagation.

Self-serve link: https://console.redwood.ai/erasure/start?acct=0987

I've attached a short guide with the recommended mutual action plan (MAP) so we stay aligned (selfserve_instructions.pdf). If you prefer us to run the job, reply \"Please run\" and I'll escalate to Ops.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142
